redCandidate.publicEntry: default aios_orchestrate MCP selection, aios_plan_task JSON response, and candidate proposal confirmation
redCandidate.setup: Use isolated multi-task plans, malicious task IDs, and temporary node:sqlite codemap fixtures.
redCandidate.expected: Default orchestration chooses persisted contextual pending work, MCP returns structured argv rather than shell text, and codemap relations survive candidate limits.
redCandidate.observed: Four tests fail: shell command interpolation is returned, default selection chooses an empty earlier task, and direct targets exhaust the candidate limit.
redCandidate.failureReason: Selection ranks only topology; confirmation output renders untrusted task IDs as shell text; candidate truncation ranks targets above all codemap relations.
